description: Begin at the exact installed neutral pose; gently enter the motion.
Small standing knee pulses and head accents; ease into a hold.
Hold a small standing head turn; this replaces the baby freeze.
Resume gentle knee pulses and head accents; ease into the second hold.
Hold the opposite head turn, standing on both feet; this replaces the chair freeze.
Small standing knee pulses and head accents; two standing holds replace floor freezes. No crossed legs, windmills or power moves.
Ease out of the motion and finish at the exact installed neutral pose.
